articles.title: Peak Has Been Leaked for PS5 by the ESRB
articles.summary: The beloved co-op adventure game, Peak, has been leaked for PS5 by the ESRB.
articles.body:
The beloved co-op adventure game, Peak , has been leaked for PS5 by the ESRB.

Last year, an adorable, cheap co-op game known as Peak blew up on Steam . In the game, players unite with their friends to pass through a wide variety of deadly obstacles in order to climb absurdly tall mountains. They must use the power of friendship and a handful of tools to overcome the odds, often resulting in hilarious deaths, injuries, and hijinks. As of August 2025, Peak has sold over 10 million copies , partially thanks to the fact it only costs $8 and is an easy sell to a group of friends.

It seems like the game will likely only continue to grow its audience, as the ESRB has rated Peak for PS5. Historically, ESRB leaks are incredibly accurate, so it seems like only a matter of time before an official announcement is made. As of right now, it's unclear if Peak will also come to Xbox and Nintendo Switch 2, but it would be surprising if this remained console exclusive to PS5.

Unfortunately for new players, Peak ended its post-launch support earlier this summer. As a result, you probably shouldn't expect the game to receive any significant content after it releases on console. It's also unclear if it will enjoy the same exceptionally low price when it does hit consoles, but it would be surprising if the team behind the game changed it. Following the game's release, the team noted that there's a psychology behind pricing a game that low .

“We had this joke of, like, 'How much is a game really?'" said Peak co-creator Nick Kaman. "In a player’s mind, what does it mean to spend five bucks? Well, that’s five bucks. But six bucks? Well, that’s still five bucks. Four bucks is also kind of five bucks. Three bucks is two bucks. And two bucks is basically free. So we’ve got these tiers: You know, twelve bucks… that’s ten bucks. But thirteen bucks is fifteen bucks. And we found that eight bucks is still five bucks. It doesn’t become ten bucks. Seven ninety nine, that’s five bucks, right? So, eight bucks going to five bucks is the biggest differential we could find in pricing, so we found it very optimal.”

It's unclear when an official announcement might follow, but if there's an ESRB rating, it typically means that the game isn't too far away from a release.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: Fanttik Has a Great Deal on an All-in-One Electric Air Duster and Power Bank
articles.summary: For a limited time, you can pick up the Fanttik B10 Pro Max Electric Air Duster and Power Bank for $44.99 with free shipping after you apply this coupon code.
articles.body:
Fanttik has a pretty cool accessory that covers both maintenance and energy recharge in one compact device. For a limited time, you can pick up the Fanttik B10 Pro Max Electric Air Duster and Power Bank for $44.99 with free shipping after you apply coupon code " IGNB10PM ". You don't need to be an Amazon Prime member to take advantage of this deal.

Fanttik B10 Pro Max Electric Air Duster and Power Bank in One

Fanttik B10 Pro Max Electric Air Duster and Power Bank

The Fanttik B10 Pro Max is first and foremost an electric air duster. This palm-sized device features a 130,000 RPM brushless fan that pushes air at a velocity of 65m/s with a "megaboost" button for an extra surge of airflow. There are six levels of intensity, and the highest level is more than enough power to clear out the dust from your PC or the grime from your keyboard. Four different nozzles are included, including one that allows you to fill air up in inflatables.

Two 4,000mAh batteries (8,000mAh total) allows you to use the air duster cordlessly, and therein lies its second use an 8,000mAh power bank. You don't want to use this as your main battery backup for your electronics, since it's bulkier than your typical power bank and the USB-C port only has a maximum output of 10W. However, it's quite useful in a pinch, and I'm not sure why other electric air dusters don't have this functionality since nearly all of them run off lithium batteries. The USB-C connectivity means it is natively compatible with most devices, including your iPhone 18 or Nintendo Switch.

Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
